services.name: ai.v1.AssistantService
services.doc:
AssistantService is the Polyester trading assistant. A user sends a
 message, which starts a run: the assistant's answer, with the tools,
 skills and subagents it uses. The run continues on the server when no
 client watches it, and its events can be replayed and resumed with
 WatchRun.

 Requests are authenticated with a session token. Every conversation, run,
 approval and memory belongs to the authenticated user; another user's
 resource is reported exactly as a missing one. The assistant reads the
 user's account data with the user's own permissions, and an action that
 changes the account, such as placing an order, runs only after the user
 approves it with DecideApproval.

methods.name: CancelRun
methods.summary: CancelRun asks an active run to stop. It returns once the request is
methods.doc:
CancelRun asks an active run to stop. It returns once the request is
 recorded; the run then ends with RunFailed and category CANCELLED, and its
 subagents stop too. A pending approval of the run expires. Cancelling a
 run that already ended changes nothing and succeeds.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: RUN_NOT_FOUND.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the same request.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: CompleteAssistantKeys
methods.summary: CompleteAssistantKeys finishes a setup once SetAssistantKeys registered
methods.doc:
CompleteAssistantKeys finishes a setup once SetAssistantKeys registered
 its public keys: the assistant starts using them, and drops the keys the
 registration replaced or left out. Completing a completed setup returns
 the keys again.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: KEY_SETUP_NOT_FOUND.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: KEY_SETUP_NOT_REGISTERED; nothing changed.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the same request.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: DecideApproval
methods.summary: DecideApproval approves or rejects a pending approval request of one of
methods.doc:
DecideApproval approves or rejects a pending approval request of one of
 the caller's runs. An approved action runs exactly as its summary says,
 at most once. Repeating the same decision returns the recorded state.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED or APPROVAL_EXPIRED.
 - UNAVAILABLE, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE or an unknown
   outcome; retry the same request.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: DeleteMemory
methods.summary: DeleteMemory makes the assistant forget one memory. Later runs no longer
methods.doc:
DeleteMemory makes the assistant forget one memory. Later runs no longer
 use it. Deleting a memory that is already deleted succeeds.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: MEMORY_NOT_FOUND.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the same request.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: GetTelegramApprovalLimits
methods.summary: GetTelegramApprovalLimits reads the caller's optional limits on what
methods.doc:
GetTelegramApprovalLimits reads the caller's optional limits on what
 they may approve from Telegram, and the notional value approved from
 Telegram in the last 24 hours.

 Errors:
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry later.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: ListAssistantKeys
methods.summary: ListAssistantKeys lists the assistant keys the assistant holds for the
methods.doc:
ListAssistantKeys lists the assistant keys the assistant holds for the
 caller, at most one per account. An account without one has no account
 tools in a conversation. To turn the assistant's access off, revoke the
 keys with DeleteAssistantKeys; the assistant then stops using them.

 Errors:
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry later.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: ListConversations
methods.summary: ListConversations lists the caller's conversations, most recently updated
methods.doc:
ListConversations lists the caller's conversations, most recently updated
 first.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request or page token.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry later.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: ListMemories
methods.summary: ListMemories lists what the assistant remembers about the caller, newest
methods.doc:
ListMemories lists what the assistant remembers about the caller, newest
 first. Each memory carries its kind: a PROFILE memory applies to every
 answer, the others are used when relevant to a message.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request or page token.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry later.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: ListMessages
methods.summary: ListMessages lists the messages of one of the caller's conversations,
methods.doc:
ListMessages lists the messages of one of the caller's conversations,
 newest first.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request or page token.
 - NOT_FOUND: CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry later.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: PrepareAssistantKeys
methods.summary: PrepareAssistantKeys starts setting up the keys the assistant acts with:
methods.doc:
PrepareAssistantKeys starts setting up the keys the assistant acts with:
 it generates one Ed25519 key pair per account, keeps the private keys,
 and returns the public keys with their registration proofs and deadline.
 Then register them, with the policy of each account, in one
 SetAssistantKeys request with a fresh step-up proof before the deadline,
 and call CompleteAssistantKeys. The step-up proof goes to
 SetAssistantKeys only, never to the assistant. A setup replaces no key
 until it is registered.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request, or an account named twice.
 - RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED; too many setups are pending.
   Complete one or wait until it expires.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the request.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.summary: SendMessage records the caller's message and starts a run that answers
methods.doc:
SendMessage records the caller's message and starts a run that answers
 it. It returns once the run is recorded; follow the run with WatchRun. A
 conversation runs one run at a time. It is idempotent per caller and key:
 repeat the request unchanged to resolve an unknown outcome.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: RUN_ACTIVE; nothing is recorded.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; the original run stands.
 - RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED; retry later.
 - UNAVAILABLE, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE or an unknown
   outcome; retry the same request.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: SetTelegramApprovalLimits
methods.summary: SetTelegramApprovalLimits replaces the caller's optional limits on what
methods.doc:
SetTelegramApprovalLimits replaces the caller's optional limits on what
 they may approve from Telegram. A limit left unset is turned off. Only a
 signed-in session sets them, never Telegram; they apply to the next
 approval from Telegram.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the same request.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: WatchRun
methods.summary: WatchRun streams a run's events in seq order: first the recorded events
methods.doc:
WatchRun streams a run's events in seq order: first the recorded events
 after after_seq, then new events as they are recorded. The stream ends
 after the run's last event, RunCompleted or RunFailed; watching an ended
 run replays its events and ends. The server may also end the stream
 early, for example during maintenance: reconnect with the seq of the last
 event received to continue without gaps or repeats. Watching does not
 keep a run alive, and a run continues when nobody watches it.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: RUN_NOT_FOUND.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; reconnect with the last seq.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.
